entities.summary: Tue Lassen is a Danish orienteering competitor. At the World Games in 2013 he won a silver medal in the mixed relay with the Danish team. Lassen won the Bronze medal in the sprint at the 2014 World Orienteering Championships. He runs for OK Pan Århus and Silkeborg OK.
